```{r setup-mascot_colour_roles, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_colour_roles-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_colour_roles")
```

```{r mascot_colour_roles-heading, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
guide_heading(paste0(mascot::mascot_character(studio_character)$name, "'s parts"), "Parts")
```

Leaders adopt the colours you supply. Followers copy the first leader you customise, shaded the same,
lighter, or darker, unless you customise them directly. Low contrast against the page warns in development
mode and previews; the colour is kept. The mascot.contrast_warnings option forces R warnings on or off.

```{r mascot_colour_roles-table, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$p(class = "pg-muted", "Low contrast also warns in this studio; the colour is kept."),
  shiny::uiOutput("roles_table")
) else guide_each_character(guide_roles_table)
```

```{r mascot_colour_roles-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_colour_roles", studio_character)
```
